rules.claim: DeleteSpaceMember first obtains the current space user; failure returns before deletion.
The request name is resolved to a space, target user, caller membership, and target membership.
The self-removal branch is reachable when targetUser.ID equals currentUser.ID.
On the self branch, execution proceeds to Store.DeleteSpaceMember for the target membership and current user ID, subject to later store result handling.
The different-member branch is reachable when targetUser.ID is not currentUser.ID.
A different-member removal invokes requireSpaceAdministrator on callerMembership; failure returns before the store deletion.
If the administrator check returns no error, execution proceeds to Store.DeleteSpaceMember for the target membership and current user ID, subject to later store result handling.

policyRules.text: Only a space administrator may remove another member from that space.
This policy does not prohibit a member leaving the space themselves.
